description: Spacious apartment on two levels, tastefully decorated and located in the 11th district of Paris. You will live like a Parisian near shops, cafés and public transports. Plenty of light and a unique feel to it. The Marché Bastille is 14 minutes walk; Père Lachaise is 12 minutes away by foot; Pâtisserie Cyril Lignac at 3 minutes walk. Closest metro is Charonne 3 minutes away.The spaceLarge 160 m2 loft two levels located on the ground floor with:- Furnished veranda, - Living room with a bay window, - Three bedrooms with queen size beds (160cm), - One bedroom with two single beds, - A shower room, - A bath room, - Open kitchen (coffee machine, toaster, fridge, freezer, hotplates, oven, microwave, dishwasher), - Washing machine, dryer, hairdryer, ironing equipment, a wardrobe, - Wi-Fi, TV and fan. - Bed linens, towels, soap, shampoo.Guest accessYou will be welcomed by my friend Jairo. Please see messages exchanged.
